The model node is done: `due` is supported in `src/model/todo.ts`, and all 109 tests across the project pass.

The task text asks for the whole chain (`add --due`, list display, CLI support), but this node's rules limit writes to `src/model/**`. I left the store, add, list, and CLI files alone, so those parts are not done.

- `Todo` has an optional `due?: string`. The field is only present when a date is set, so existing todos and deep-equal tests are unchanged.
